lexical_comparators.description: Name-free texts with X-codes stripped; TF-IDF with phylo.py settings (English stop words, min_df 2, sublinear tf). Word presence: a word is present in a work when it occurs there; optional words are present in 2-16 of the 32 Batman works, as for units. Same E2 statistic, hub adjustment, time rule and 10,000-permutation joint relabelling as the neurons.
